events.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon—what do you know about it?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Gus: I’ve heard they’re lining up a few folks to help fix small stuff around the neighborhood—things like bikes, shelves, and loose handles. If you want, I can check whether they need any tools or extra hands.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks—I'm mostly hearing bits and pieces, so any details help. If they need extra hands, I might be able to stop by.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is ready to go?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got the tools lined up and I’m ready to help.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming — you’re actually ready to head out, right?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Opal: Gus, could you check the community hall address and parking access first? If those look good, I’ll fill in the rest of the repair drive details.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll check the community hall address and parking access first, then I’ll let you know so you can fill in the rest.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Gus — once you confirm those, I’ll fill in the rest of the repair drive details.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Tess: Oh, lovely — the repair drive’s been getting a nice bit of attention. If you’ve got anything needing a fix, just bring it by and I’ll make sure folks point you the right way.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — I’ve got my tools ready, and I can help steer folks your way if you need an extra hand.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be brilliant, Gus — an extra hand is always welcome. Just keep sending folks over, and I’ll be right here to help them out.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Gus: Yep, I’m ready to head out — I just need to double-check the hall address and parking first, then we’re good to go.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — it’s at the community center on Sunday now, and I’ll send the hall address plus parking details right over. Let’s keep the urgent safety fixes first once everyone’s there.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Gus: Perfect, Rosa — send those details when you can, and I’ll keep the safety fixes at the top of the list.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Gus: I’m checking the community hall address and parking access now. If those are good, I’ll pass them along so Opal can fill in the rest.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I’m still hearing bits and pieces, so that would help a lot. I’ll keep asking around about the drop-off timing and let you know if I hear anything useful.

events.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve confirmed the hall address and parking access. Thanks for keeping an ear out on the drop-off timing too.

events.text: Gus: I’m still waiting on the hall address and parking details, then I can help lock the repair drive in.

events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Mina: I’m bringing the tape and screws by later today — do you need anything else for the repair drive?
